report.summary: Two critical PHP flaws are being actively exploited with a public proof-of-concept, prompting Australian patching urgency. Domestically, the PM's new AI tsar is courting US frontier labs, while a supply-chain compromise of the Claude Code VS Code extension shows AI developer tooling under attack. Reports of a China-linked group using agentic AI for rapid pentesting underline that shift, and GitLab admins face active exploitation of a maximum-severity flaw.

items.title: PM’s AI tsar promises local innovation wave from training
items.why: Australia's new Office of AI is courting US frontier AI labs, promising a local innovation wave.

items.title: [CRITICAL] PHP2Shell: What to know about two critical PHP flaws
items.why: Two critical PHP flaws, including one listed in CVE records as CVE-2026-109618, are now on CISA's exploited list with a public proof-of-concept. Australian PHP deployments need immediate patching.

items.title: Official Claude Code VS Code Extension Compromised to Install Persistent SSH Backdoor
items.why: The official Claude Code VS Code extension was tampered with on Open VSX to install a persistent SSH backdoor.

items.title: Crypto's biggest withdrawal.
items.why: A roundup ties together a large Binance theft, exploitation of the critical GitLab flaw and an emerging AI-powered command-and-control framework — a useful single check for teams tracking multiple…

items.title: China-backed threat group used agentic AI pentesting tool to compromise 140 sensitive targets in 11 days
items.why: A China-linked group reportedly used an agentic AI pentesting tool to breach about 140 targets in 11 days, showing how AI compresses attack timelines and leaves defenders little reaction window.
